term.ungradedExercise: This Exercise isn't graded, so it has no pass mark.

term.evenNoMs: I can't put this Exercise's evenness pass mark in milliseconds: its beat isn't a quarter note.
term.evenMs: The evenness pass mark here is {{bar}}%: at {{bpm}} BPM, with this Exercise's closest notes {{gap}} ms apart, it allows a spread of about {{ms}} ms around your own average timing.
term.holdMs: The pass mark for evenness held to the end is {{bar}}%, measured over the closing bars of the stretch judged: at {{bpm}} BPM, with this Exercise's closest notes {{gap}} ms apart, it allows a spread of about {{ms}} ms around your own average timing.
term.heardMark: {{bar}}% is the notes-heard pass mark: in the bars judged, at least {{bar}} of every 100 written notes must be heard.
term.accentsMark: {{bar}}% is the accents pass mark: at least {{bar}} of every 100 marked accents must come out louder than the notes around them.
term.notesMark: {{bar}}% is the right-notes pass mark: at least {{bar}} of every 100 notes I could pitch must be the written ones.
term.markOther: {{value}}% is the pass mark of another of this Exercise's checks, not its evenness.
term.markAlso: {{value}}% is also the pass mark of another of this Exercise's checks.
term.evenHow: Evenness is measured around your own average timing, not the click, so a steady lean doesn't lower it.
